verdict.rationale: Jev's core System One primitives (Choice/Score/Noul) generate structured, probabilistic AI judgments over user-supplied 'state' data, and the Playground lets a user paste their own text and immediately see AI-generated answers, which is a form of in-product insight generation. However, this is fundamentally a developer API/SDK plus a lightweight testing Playground rather than an end-user product surface that surfaces proactive insights/suggestions over a persistent body of 'my data'; the real delivery of insights happens in whatever downstream app the developer builds, not inside Jev itself. Missing for 10: a native end-user dashboard/insights UI over stored user data, evidence of proactive/automatic suggestions (vs. on-demand Q&A), and independent hands-on confirmation of an in-product insights experience beyond the Playground demo.
